title: an empty AGENTS.override.md does not stop the block from going into ~/.codex/AGENTS.md
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). An empty `AGENTS.override.md` is not an override, so `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` is created and there is no warning. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
